source.title: Open Problems at the Combinatorics Workshop of AIMC25 (Tehran, 1994)

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 828013. Resolver/search metadata identified the exact work as the chapter 'Open Problems at the Combinatorics Workshop of AIMC25 (Tehran, 1994)' by E. S. Mahmoodian and M. A. Shokrollahi, published in Combinatorics Advances, pages 321-324 (1995), DOI 10.1007/978-1-4613-3554-2_23. Metadata was used only to identify the work and candidate full-text routes.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure modes: metadata_only, paywalled_or_restricted, and network_or_dns_failure. Attempted identifiers and candidate routes included the original zbMATH resolver, the zbMATH REST endpoint pattern https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/828013, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4613-3554-2_23, the Springer chapter and book pages, the Springer PDF URL pattern, the Infoscience record and API item pattern for UUID 9517e98b-1552-4239-a86e-c5ad3c637422, Google Books and Google Play book pages, and exact-title/PDF searches. Rejected candidates because they exposed only resolver metadata, tables of contents, book previews, purchase/subscription pages, or snippets without the chapter body containing the problem statements. Local shell fetches of zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and infoscience.epfl.ch failed because external DNS/network access is unavailable in the sandbox. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/828013.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
